fixes.fix: Fiscal week labels match the calendar each page uses
Peer comparisons use the same three peers as the brief
"Up" and "down" are checked against the period the user asked about

Check the feed's load time before answering. Until today's close lands, the brief and the chatbot say "price not updated yet".

causes.title: Late share-price feed
causes.summary: the share-price feed landed at 7:40, after the 7:00 brief, so the brief and 6 answers quoted Thursday's close
causes.fix: Check the feed's load time before answering. Until today's close lands, the brief and the chatbot say "price not updated yet".

ex.a: SNDY closed at <mark>$48.36</mark> on Friday, <mark>−0.9%</mark> on the day.
ex.jwhy: Clear and cited to the price table. Accuracy is low because the checker found both figures are Thursday's, not Friday's.
ex.inl: Passed — the brief matched the price it read. Friday's close hadn't landed, so it read Thursday's.

ex.q: How did our shares do on Friday?
ex.a: SNDY closed at <mark>$48.36</mark> on Friday, <mark>down 0.9%</mark> on the day.
ex.jwhy: Answers the question and cites the price table. Accuracy is low because the checker found both figures are Thursday's, not Friday's.
ex.inl: Passed — the answer matched the price the agent read. Friday's close hadn't landed, so it read Thursday's.

causes.title: "Last week" read as the week before
causes.summary: 2 answers on Monday morning read "last week" as the week before last, because Sunday's sales hadn't closed the week yet
causes.fixY: Confirmed. Draft fix: "last week" always means the last full week. Until Sunday's sales land, the answer says the week isn't complete.
causes.fixN: Marked as a false alarm. The judge is told why, so it scores this case differently next time.

ex.a: Sales were <mark>$13.18M</mark> last week, <mark>up 1.0%</mark> on the week before.
ex.jwhy: Answers the question in the right shape, but both figures describe the week before last.
ex.inl: Passed — the agent read the week before last and quoted it correctly. Sunday's sales hadn't closed the week yet.

causes.title: Peer margin isn't in the data
causes.summary: one answer gave Halden & Co's gross margin, which no source holds
causes.fix: Draft: peer questions cover share price only; anything else about a peer gets "not in this data".

ex.a: Halden & Co's gross margin is <mark>about 61%</mark>, a little below ours.
claims: no source — peers have share price only
ex.jwhy: No source holds peer margins. The figure is invented, and the comparison with ours rests on it.
ex.inl: Nothing to compare — no source holds this number, so the claim goes to the judge.

causes.title: "Recovering" after one better week
causes.summary: "recovering" was used after a single better week — 3 answers
causes.fix: Draft rule: "recovering" and "rebounding" only when the last two weeks both improved; otherwise "better than the week before".

ex.q: How is Footwear doing in Japan?
ex.a: Footwear is <mark>recovering</mark>: −6.7% vs LY last week, better than −10.6% the week before.
ex.jwhy: Both numbers are right. "Recovering" overstates one better week — Footwear is still below where it was three weeks ago (−4.9%).
ex.inl: Passed — both numbers matched. "Recovering" wasn't on its list of direction words yet.

causes.title: Asked about all channels, read Online
causes.summary: one answer about "Bags in the UK" read Online only, because the page was filtered to Online
causes.fix: "In the UK" means all channels unless the user names one, and every answer says which channels it covers.

ex.q: How did Bags do in the UK last week?
ex.a: Bags sold <mark>£55.1K</mark> last week, <mark>+3.5%</mark> vs LY.
ex.jwhy: Right category and week, but "in the UK" means every channel; the figures are Online only.
ex.inl: Passed — the page was filtered to Online, and the answer matched what the agent read.

causes.title: Stock snapshot a week old
causes.summary: the store stock feed stopped updating, so 4 weeks-of-supply answers used the week-before stock
causes.fix: Draft: check the stock snapshot's date before answering; if it is older than a day, the answer says so.

ex.q: How many weeks of supply do we have on Cloud Crew?
ex.a: Cloud Crew has <mark>7.0 weeks</mark> of supply, selling about 3,977 units a week.
claims: Weeks of supply, end of last week
7.7 · answer used the stock from a week earlier
ex.jwhy: Clear and on-topic; the checker found the stock figure behind it is a week old.
ex.inl: Passed — the answer matched the stock the agent read. The stock feed hadn't updated since the week before.

causes.title: Asked to send an email
causes.summary: one answer was asked to email the team and replied with sales figures instead of saying it can't
causes.fix: Draft: requests to send, share or schedule get "I can't send messages — here's a link to this view".

ex.q: Can you send last week's numbers to my team?
ex.a: Net sales last week were $2.91M, +2.7% vs LY.
ex.jwhy: The numbers are right, but the user asked for an action the agent can't take, and the answer doesn't say so.

causes.title: Returns aren't in the data
causes.summary: one answer gave a reason for returns, which this agent has no data on
causes.fix: "Returns" joins the out-of-scope list — the agent now answers "Returns aren't in this data".

ex.q: Why are returns up on mobile?
ex.a: Returns are up because shoppers find the <mark>Juniper Tote runs smaller than expected</mark>.
ex.jwhy: Returns aren't in this agent's data, and no source mentions sizing. The answer invents a cause.
ex.inl: Nothing to check — the answer has no numbers.

causes.title: Judge didn't know click-to-open
causes.summary: the judge flagged click-to-open as not in the data; it is one of the eCom agent's metrics
causes.fix: False alarm: click-to-open is one of the eCom agent's defined metrics. The judge now reads each agent's metric list before it scores.

ex.q: Which email did best last week?
ex.a: "Holiday gift guide" had the best click-to-open: 16.5%.
ex.jwhy: Click-to-open doesn't appear in the cited sources.

causes.title: Email revenue before late orders landed
causes.summary: one Monday answer quoted email revenue before the weekend's late orders were matched to their sends
causes.fix: Draft: on Mondays, email revenue waits for the 9:00 matching job; before that the answer says the week isn't final.

ex.q: How much revenue did email drive last week?
ex.a: Email drove <mark>$276.4K</mark> of revenue last week.
ex.jwhy: On-topic and cited; the checker found the figure is lower than the final one.
ex.inl: Passed — the answer matched what the agent read. The weekend's late orders hadn't been matched to their sends yet.

causes.title: Asked about mobile, read all devices
causes.summary: one answer about mobile conversion read all devices, because the page was on All devices
causes.fix: Draft: a device in the question overrides the page's Device filter, and the answer names the device.

ex.q: What was mobile conversion last week?
ex.jwhy: Answers a conversion question, but not for mobile, and doesn't say which devices it covers.
ex.inl: Passed — the page was on All devices, and the answer matched what the agent read.
